hero.name: Waheed Abbas
hero.headline: I build production-style AI systems — agents, RAG and ML backends.
hero.intro: Computer Science graduate focused on Agentic AI with LangGraph, FastAPI backends and local-first LLM workflows. I build systems milestone by milestone: architecture, tests, security and a working application.

paragraphs: I'm a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer and Agentic AI Engineer based in Pakistan. I hold a BS in Computer Science from Government College University Faisalabad (2024).

My work centres on turning AI ideas into software that behaves like software: typed APIs, persisted state, human approval steps, tests and clear documentation. I'm growing towards production AI engineering and AI systems architecture.
